name: fs-watcher-plugin
description: Watch a file or directory for changes and trigger workflows on create, modify, and delete events.
author: AGNT

schema.title: File/Directory Watcher
schema.description: Watches a file or directory path for changes (create, modify, delete). Auto-detects whether the path is a file or a directory from a single input.

watchPath.description: Absolute path to watch. Can be a file or a directory - the trigger auto-detects which.

recursive.description: Watch subdirectories recursively (only applies to directories).

fireOnStart.description: Fire once immediately when the workflow starts.

events.description: Comma-separated events to listen for: add (new file), change (modified), unlink (deleted), addDir (dir created), unlinkDir (dir removed).

ignorePatterns.description: Glob patterns to ignore, one per line.

debounceMs.description: Write-stability debounce in ms. Prevents rapid-fire triggers while a file is still being written.

event.description: The event type: add, change, unlink, addDir, unlinkDir, or initial-scan

filePath.description: Absolute path of the changed file/directory

directory.description: Parent directory of the changed file

extension.description: File extension (e.g. '.js') or empty for directories

isDirectory.description: Whether the changed path is a directory

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp of when the change was detected

stats.description: File stats (size, mtime, etc.) when available - null for delete events
